scope: Where the Rust rewrite's structure still differs from the Go owner it ports, from the 2026-11-22 file-level re-audit (method in structural-audit-2026-11-22.md).

findings.finding: ANALYZE is not fully in Go's shape. The planner's `buildAnalyze*` / `getMustAnalyzedColumns` / `genV2AnalyzeOptions` still run at execution time in `real_tikv_analyze.rs` (`resolve_cluster_analyze_statement`, over a fresh TiKV catalog snapshot), and `analyze_idx.go`'s `AnalyzeIndexExec` (`buildStats`, `fetchAnalyzeResult`, `buildStatsFromResult`) is folded into `cluster_analyze/sampling.rs`'s `collect_index_stats`. Done: globalstats (`tidb-stats-handle-globalstats/src/global_stats.rs`), `AnalyzeExec.Next` (`analyze_exec_next`, `analyze_worker.rs`, `analyze_global_stats.rs`), and `buildSamplingStats`' `readDataAndSendTask` / `subMergeWorker` / `subBuildWorker` / `handleNDVForSpecialIndexes`.
